product_overview: Athena-Academic is a five-page academic assistant for managing daily tasks, PDF processing, workouts, and free-form ideas from a single dashboard. It also provides an agent chat terminal and daily note workflow to help users organize study work and planning in one place.
core_goals: Review today’s tasks and track daily workload from the dashboard
Write and auto-save a daily note
Chat with the agent, use slash commands, and attach files for assistance
Upload PDFs and monitor processing history, usage, and live logs
Create, edit, complete, and organize academic and daily tasks with notes, materials, subtasks, and attachments
Create, import, edit, complete, and sync workouts
Capture and manage free-form ideas with rich text and file attachments

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Users can move between the five main pages and see which page is currently active.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Günüm nav link -> See the dashboard page highlighted as active
Navigate to / -> Click PDF Otomasyonu nav link -> See the PDF Automation page highlighted as active
Navigate to / -> Click Görevler nav link -> See the Task Management page highlighted as active
Navigate to / -> Click Antrenman nav link -> See the Workout Management page highlighted as active
Navigate to / -> Click Fikir Defteri nav link -> See the Ideas Notebook page highlighted as active

features.name: Dashboard and Daily Note
features.description: Users can review today’s tasks, filter them by time or status, and write a rich-text daily note that saves automatically.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View task cards sorted by deadline -> Filter tasks by time -> Filter tasks by status -> See the task list update
Navigate to / -> Type in the daily note rich text editor -> Pause or continue editing -> See the auto-save indicator update
Navigate to / -> Open the dashboard -> Review cognitive capacity information -> Compare daily workload with task priority

features.name: Chat Terminal
features.description: Users can send messages to the agent, use slash commands, attach files, switch sessions, and export chat history as markdown.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type message in chat input -> Send message -> See streaming response tokens appear live
Navigate to / -> Type a slash command such as /yardim -> Send message -> See the agent respond with command-aware output
Navigate to / -> Attach PDF or image file to chat -> Send message -> See the attachment included in the conversation
Navigate to / -> Switch between chat sessions -> Continue the conversation in the selected session
Navigate to / -> Export chat session as markdown -> Download the exported conversation

features.name: PDF Automation
features.description: Users can upload PDF files for automated processing, inspect past jobs, monitor usage costs, and watch live system logs.
user_flows: Navigate to /pdf -> Drag and drop PDF file onto dropzone -> Enter optional processing instructions -> Start upload -> See the job appear in history
Navigate to /pdf -> View past PDF jobs with status badges -> Refresh PDF job list -> See updated job statuses and entries
Navigate to /pdf -> View API cost meters for pdf and agent categories -> Compare usage across both channels
Navigate to /pdf -> Watch live system logs stream -> Expand log panel to modal view -> Inspect the logs in a larger view
Navigate to /pdf -> Download PDF job artifacts -> Save the generated files locally

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Users can create and manage academic and daily tasks, add notes and materials, upload files, generate subtasks, analyze notes, and filter tasks.
user_flows: Navigate to /manage -> Create new academic or daily task -> Fill in task details -> Save the task -> See the new task in the list
Navigate to /manage -> Edit a task title, deadline, discipline, or estimated hours -> Save changes -> See the updated task card
Navigate to /manage -> Mark a task as complete -> See the task status change to completed
Navigate to /manage -> Delete a task -> See the task removed from the list
Navigate to /manage -> Open a task -> Add a note -> Save the note -> See the note attached to the task
Navigate to /manage -> Open a task -> Add a material link -> Save the link -> See the material stored with the task
Navigate to /manage -> Open a task -> Upload a file attachment -> See the file attached to the task
Navigate to /manage -> Open a project task -> Generate AI subtasks -> See subtasks added under the task
Navigate to /manage -> Analyze all notes with AI -> See the analyzed results applied to workload and progress
Navigate to /manage -> Filter tasks by category and status -> See the list narrow to matching tasks

features.name: Workout Management
features.description: Users can view workout plans, create and edit workouts, mark sessions complete, import workout files, sync from Runalyze, and bring in multi-day training plans.
user_flows: Navigate to /workouts -> View planned and completed workouts -> Compare workout status across sessions
Navigate to /workouts -> Create new workout with duration and RPE -> Save the workout -> See it added to the plan
Navigate to /workouts -> Mark a planned workout as complete -> See the workout move to completed
Navigate to /workouts -> Edit workout details in modal -> Save changes -> See updated workout information
Navigate to /workouts -> Delete a workout -> See the workout removed from the list
Navigate to /workouts -> Upload JSON, CSV, or FIT file -> Import workouts -> See the imported workouts added
Navigate to /workouts -> Sync workouts from Runalyze -> See workouts brought into the app
Navigate to / -> Use chat to import a multi-day training plan -> See the plan converted into workouts

features.name: Ideas Notebook
features.description: Users can create free-form ideas, edit them with rich text, add materials and files, and delete entries when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /ideas -> Click + Fikir Ekle -> Create a new idea card -> See the idea appear in the notebook
Navigate to /ideas -> Click an idea card -> Open the editor modal -> Edit the title and rich text content -> Save changes
Navigate to /ideas -> Open an idea -> Add a material link -> Save the link -> See it stored with the idea
Navigate to /ideas -> Open an idea -> Upload a file attachment -> See the file attached to the idea
Navigate to /ideas -> Delete an idea -> See the idea removed from the notebook

routes.description: Günüm — dashboard with today's tasks, cognitive load, daily note editor, and chat terminal
PDF Otomasyonu — PDF history, API cost meters, upload dropzone, live log stream
Görevler — academic and daily task CRUD with notes, materials, subtasks
Antrenman — planned/completed workouts, metrics, file import, Runalyze sync
Fikir Defteri — free-form ideas with rich text editor and file attachments

known_limitations.issue: No user authentication — all features are open without login
known_limitations.impact: Tests do not require login flow

known_limitations.issue: PDF full pipeline can take minutes due to LaTeX compilation
known_limitations.impact: Upload tests may need extended timeout

known_limitations.issue: Chat and AI features require OPENROUTER_API_KEY on backend
known_limitations.impact: Chat returns 503 if API key not configured

known_limitations.issue: Runalyze sync requires RUNALYZE_TOKEN environment variable
known_limitations.impact: Sync button fails silently or errors without token
